Conector piloto activo

An active data connection port on the bridge that provides real-time navigational data from the ship's ECDIS or AIS system for the pilot’s portable unit.

Quick answer: An active data connection port on the bridge that provides real-time navigational data from the ship's ECDIS or AIS system for the pilot’s portable unit.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Conector piloto activo?

In this glossary, Conector piloto activo refers to: An active data connection port on the bridge that provides real-time navigational data from the ship's ECDIS or AIS system for the pilot’s portable unit.

How is Conector piloto activo used in maritime?

In maritime communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Práctico al puente: Active el conector piloto y confirme que la transferencia de datos desde ECDIS está activa antes de acercarse al dique."

Why does Conector piloto activo matter in maritime?

Conector piloto activo matters because it supports clear communication in Nav contexts for Deck Officers, Engine Officers, and Masters. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as STCW, Marlins Test, ISF Watchkeeper, and GMDSS.

Definition

An active data connection port on the bridge that provides real-time navigational data from the ship's ECDIS or AIS system for the pilot’s portable unit.

Operational example

Pilot to bridge: Please enable the live pilot plug and confirm data transfer from ECDIS is active before we approach the breakwater.

Localized term

Conector piloto activo

Localized example

Práctico al puente: Active el conector piloto y confirme que la transferencia de datos desde ECDIS está activa antes de acercarse al dique.
